# Pair Networks

> Buy a domain, get reliable website hosting, and launch with affordable web design. Everything you need to build and grow your online presence, backed by 30+ years of independent, US-based hosting.

Pair Networks is an independent web hosting company with data centers in Pittsburgh, PA and Denver, CO. Services span domain registration, shared and VPS hosting, managed WordPress hosting, professional email, and custom web design and ongoing site management.

## Hosting
- [Shared Hosting](https://www.pair.com/shared-hosting/): Shared web hosting plans for personal sites, blogs, and small businesses.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.pair.com/wordpress-hosting/): Managed WordPress hosting with one-click installs, automatic updates, and performance tuning.
- [VPS Hosting](https://www.pair.com/vps-hosting/): Virtual private servers with dedicated resources and root-level control.
- [Help Me Choose](https://www.pair.com/help-me-choose/): Guided comparison to pick the right hosting plan.

## Domains
- [Domains](https://www.pair.com/domains/): Domain registration, transfers, DNS, and privacy.
- [Domains Pricing](https://www.pair.com/domains-pricing/): Registration and renewal pricing by TLD.
- [Domains Features](https://www.pair.com/domains-features/): DNS management, dynamic DNS, domain privacy, and security features.

## Email
- [Pair Platinum Mail](https://www.pair.com/pair-platinum-mail/): Professional, ad-free email hosting with webmail, IMAP/POP access, and built-in security.

## Web Design & Site Services
- [Custom Web Design](https://www.pair.com/custom-web-design/): Fully custom, conversion-focused WordPress website design.
- [QuickSite](https://www.pair.com/quicksite/): Fast, template-based WordPress site setup and launch.
- [Website Rebuild](https://www.pair.com/rebuild/): Audit-driven redesign and rebuild of existing WordPress sites.
- [Pair Care](https://www.pair.com/care/): Ongoing WordPress maintenance, updates, monitoring, backups, and support plans.
- [Pair Site Builder](https://www.pair.com/pair-site-builder/): Drag-and-drop website builder for quick DIY sites.
- [WP Site Builder](https://www.pair.com/wp-site-builder/): AI WordPress-based visual site builder.

## Add-on Services & Features
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.pair.com/ssl-certificates/): Free and premium SSL/TLS certificates.
- [Site Backups](https://www.pair.com/site-backups/): Automated website and data backups.
- [Content Delivery Network (CDN)](https://www.pair.com/content-delivery-network-cdn/): CDN for faster global load times.
- [Software Installation Manager (SIM)](https://www.pair.com/software-installation-manager-sim/): One-click installers for WordPress, Joomla, and other applications.
- [Intrusion Defense](https://www.pair.com/intrusion-defense/): Server-level security and intrusion protection.
- [Podcast Websites](https://www.pair.com/podcast-websites/): Hosting and site setup tailored for podcasters.

## Company
- [About](https://www.pair.com/about/): Company background, support philosophy, and reliability track record.
- [Corporate Info](https://www.pair.com/corporate-info/): Legal and corporate information.
- [Careers](https://www.pair.com/careers/): Open positions and life at Pair Networks.
- [The Pair Guarantee](https://www.pair.com/pair-guarantee/): Money-back guarantee and service commitments.
- [Move to Pair](https://www.pair.com/move-to-pair/): Free migration assistance for switching hosts.
- [Contact](https://www.pair.com/contact/): Support and sales contact options.

## Optional
- [Special Offers](https://www.pair.com/special-offers/): Current promotions and discounts.
- [Referral Program](https://www.pair.com/referral-program/): Customer referral and affiliate program.
- [Sitemap index](https://www.pair.com/sitemap_index.xml): Full XML sitemap of all pages.
